2401-00-789-0238
National Sustainable
Agriculture Mission
(RKVY) (Centrally
Sponsored Scheme)
column7:
Augmentation in provision
of ₹59.99 lakh was the net
effect of increase of ₹89.91
lakh and surrender of
₹29.92 lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
Grants-in-aid-Non-Salary.
Surrender was attributed to
amendment in scheme
outlay. Final excess of
₹29.18 lakh is overstated by
₹81.18 lakh due to clearance
of OB suspense related to
previous years. Therefore, it
is actual saving of ₹52.00
lakh. Reasons for actual
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
